purpose: ConsumerSim-style downstream predictive validation with explicit non-simulation baselines.
source_method: ConsumerSim Appendix B, equations B1-B6; adapted to SCE and the four phase-1 outcomes.
common_controls: current outcome level or log level
current outcome change or log change
sce_features: Current level and one-month change; official_plus_simulated includes both official and simulated pairs.
estimator: OLS on training-standardized features; intercept unpenalized; no hyperparameter search.
ar1: Direct autoregression of the h-month-ahead transformed outcome level on its current transformed level, converted back to growth.

evaluation.A: Expanding-origin backtest; at origin t only training targets with target_date <= t; minimum 36 complete training rows.
evaluation.B: One frozen model per outcome/horizon fitted only on A targets available by the first B origin; no B outcome refitting or updating.
evaluation.in_sample: A complete-case fit, reporting R2 and pairwise delta R2.
evaluation.out_of_sample: MAE, RMSE, bias and paired proportional RMSE/MAE improvement.

missing_policy: For each outcome and horizon, complete-case deletion over the union of features needed by all models; the same origin rows are used by every model. No interpolation, forward filling, or quarterly-to-monthly interest-rate imputation.
vintage_policy: Current public vintage retrieved in phase 1; same-month macro controls follow the ConsumerSim-style retrospective design, not certified real-time release vintages.
reporting_policy: Retain and export every model, outcome, horizon, contrast and monthly prediction. Any later selective narrative must link to this complete result set and disclose the number of comparisons.
